final_draft.answer: Two. Changes to the default branch of our application repository (harborlight/app on GitHub) need two approving reviews before they can be merged. The rule also applies to administrators.
final_draft.note: This uses the approved answer for control CC8.1, valid until 2027-11-17. That answer covers the default branch of the harborlight/app repository only. The question says 'main branch', and I've taken it to mean that default branch. The source doesn't cover other repositories.

arguments.query: code review approvals before merge to main branch

answer:71ac77b9-99db-411c-ac12-271ea43aa: Yes. Changes to the default branch of our application repository (harborlight/app on GitHub) require two approving reviews before they can be merged, and the rule applies to administrators as well.
answer:733d8cf4-38db-49a7-9e6c-c580c897e: Yes. GitHub secret scanning is switched on for our application repository (harborlight/app).
answer:db7068e4-27e7-4ee1-9069-47d26a717: Yes. Our GitHub organisation (harborlight) requires two-factor sign-in for all of its members.
answer:ae0ca1c0-aa0d-4368-9868-86660f093: Infrastructure and container images are scanned weekly. Critical findings are fixed within 7 days and high findings within 30 days.
answer:ec68dacd-b513-426a-9edd-a56a31cd1: An independent firm performs a penetration test of the application and infrastructure once a year. A summary letter is available under NDA.
